target.title: [Bug]: voice-call manager crashes on answered conversation calls when realtime config is absent
target.body:
# Bug Report: Voice-Call Manager Crashes on Answered Conversation Calls when Realtime Config is Absent

**Severity:** P1 — Inbound/outbound answered calls throw TypeError and crash answered-call handler if `realtime` config object is undefined.

---

## Summary

When OpenClaw voice-call plugin is configured without an explicit `realtime` object in the configuration (e.g. standard TTS/STT conversation mode), answering any call triggers a unhandled `TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'enabled')` at `manager.ts:414`. This crashes the answered-call handler and leaves the call hanging in answered state without initial greeting or listening start.

---

## Observed Behavior

1. A voice call (inbound or outbound) is answered.
2. `onCallAnswered` fires and calls `maybeSpeakInitialMessageOnAnswered`.
3. An unhandled exception occurs: `TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'enabled')`.
4. The call is left in an unhandled state: no initial greeting plays, listening is never initiated.

---

## Expected Behavior

Optional chaining should safely evaluate `this.config.realtime?.enabled`. If `realtime` config is omitted or undefined, it should default to falsey and proceed to play initial message in conversation mode.

---

## Root Cause Analysis

**File:** `extensions/voice-call/src/manager.ts` — Line 414

```typescript
if (mode === "conversation") {
  if (this.config.realtime.enabled) { // <--- BROKEN: missing optional chaining
    return;
  }
}
```

Every other reference in the codebase uses `config.realtime?.enabled` (e.g., `events.ts:232`). This property was missed during refactoring.

---

## Affected Files

| File | Issue |
|---|---|
| `extensions/voice-call/src/manager.ts` | Missing optional chaining on `this.config.realtime.enabled` at line 414 |

---

## Impact

Affects 100% of standard voice-call setups that do not specify a `realtime` section in config.
